name: Gala Seed
author: prodrive-ac-builder
_about: The real-world seed for the game 1978 (github.com/k10-motorsports/k10-1978). NOT an AC track. Route spine: 5591 Gala Ave (Allied Gardens) -> through Del Cerro -> Benchley-Weinberger Elementary (San Carlos), with the golf course and the Lake Murray edge as landmark regions. Built by scripts/game/build_seed.py, exported by scripts/game/export_seed.py into the game repo's seed/ (contract: k10-1978/PIPELINE_BRIDGE.md).

location._anchor: 5591 Gala Ave - the start anchor (OSM node 596681395)

source._doc: route.anchors are ordered waypoints; scripts/gps/road_route.py snaps each to the nearest OSM road node and Dijkstras the on-road path between consecutive ones. The 'del_cerro' via biases the spine through Del Cerro (past the golf course) instead of the fast Navajo Rd path. REVIEW: the exact childhood route is the owner's to draw - edit anchors or replace with a My Maps KML.

landmarks._doc: OSM areas fetched by stable id, projected into the ENU frame. 'sanctum' = the golf course (the game's hand-authored spiritual anchor - the pipeline provides location/extent only); 'water' = Lake Murray; 'school'/'home' = placement anchors.

layouts._doc: Single open spine; consumed by the game, never built into a kn5.
